repairConstant.note: Judgement, not a measurement -- no Danish parts/labour cost dataset exists to fit against. Puts a median car (repair_burden_index ~0.76) near 2,300 DKK/yr of repairs, which is low but defensible given the index counts MOT failure items, not all workshop visits. See phase4_scoring_spec.md section 1.4.
Low bound for the published sensitivity check -- repair cost roughly halved.
High bound for the published sensitivity check -- at this level repair cost starts reordering brackets (~23% of median TCO vs ~7% at the primary constant).
